footstep_concrete.wav, bump_soft.wav, beacon_bell.wav are converted (ogg -> wav) from
Kenney's "Impact Sounds" pack (footstep_concrete_000.ogg, impactSoft_medium_000.ogg,
impactBell_heavy_000.ogg respectively). turn_cloth.wav is converted from Kenney's
"RPG Audio" pack (cloth2.ogg). Both packs:
